data_facts_with_para.paragraph: In 2016, 27.5% of the global adult population and 81% of adolescents failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise. Physical inactivity was responsible for 13.4 million disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) worldwide. Healthcare professionals should try to implement PA as a general treatment, as any type of PA yields positive effects on an individual’s cardiovascular health, contributing to a 27% reduction in relative risk of cardiovascular mortality.

facts.fact_content: 27.5% of the global adult population failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise in 2016.
81% of adolescents failed to meet the current guidelines for weekly exercise in 2016.
Physical inactivity was responsible for 13.4 million disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) worldwide.
27% reduction in relative risk of cardiovascular mortality due to physical activity.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: PA and increasing one’s daily step count to 6,500 steps/day are associated with a reduced relative risk of CVD-related mortality of 49% [2], as well as a reduced incidence of CVD itself [3].

facts.fact_content: Increasing daily step count to 6,500 steps/day is associated with a reduced relative risk of CVD-related mortality of 49%.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: PA can lower systolic and diastolic blood pressure with a mean of 7 mmHg and 5 mmHg, respectively [14].

facts.fact_content: PA can lower systolic blood pressure by a mean of 7 mmHg.
PA can lower diastolic blood pressure by a mean of 5 mmHg.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: PA therefore results in an increase in high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels by 5%-10%, and a decrease in general triglycerides by 50%, low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol by 5% and, therefore, total cholesterol.

facts.fact_content: PA results in an increase in high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels by 5%-10%.
PA results in a decrease in general triglycerides by 50%.
PA results in a decrease in low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol by 5%.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Engaging in moderate-intensity aerobic exercise for a minimum of 30 minutes, 4 to 5 times a week, is considered both safe and effective in almost all patients with congenital heart disease (CHD) [22].

facts.fact_content: Engaging in moderate-intensity aerobic exercise for a minimum of 30 minutes, 4 to 5 times a week, is considered safe and effective in almost all patients with congenital heart disease (CHD).
